main_measure.name: drift-adjusted position-weighted next-bar return of the short after thin up bars

statistic.name: t of the mean of drift-adjusted position gains

main_measure.threshold: above 0 with t-stat >= 2.0 to confirm; <= 0 with t-stat <= 0 to reject

supporting_check.name: mean next-bar drop vs unconditional mean, largest third minus smallest third by |position|

decided_by: The short earns 0 or less after the drift adjustment, with a t-stat of 0 or below.
reading: Cases are bars labelled regime 'mean_reversion' with a next bar in the same window, the position is postRebalance_current_allocation (zero positions kept as cases), the main value is sum(pos x (r - window mean)) / sum(|pos|) so a short gains when r falls below the mean, its t-stat is the ordinary t of the per-case gains pos x (r - mean), and thirds are the n//3 cases with smallest and largest |position|.
